| Type | Purpose |
|------|---------|
| explanation | Educational content, how things work |

| idea | Speculation, proposals, things to explore |

- app/models/entry.py (Pydantic model)
- app/api/routes.py (endpoints)
- app/templates/entry.html (UI)

See TODO.md 'Entry Types' and FEATURES.md 'Entry Types' sections

title: Add rate limiting with slowapi
description:
Protect the API from abuse without blocking legitimate use.

## Requirements
1. Add slowapi to FastAPI dependencies
2. Configure limits: 100 reads/min, 10 writes/min per IP
3. Return proper 429 responses with Retry-After header
4. Apply to all API endpoints

## Implementation
- Use slowapi (FastAPI-compatible rate limiter)
- IP-based limiting via request.client.host
- Store in memory (no Redis needed for now)

## Files likely involved
- app/main.py (middleware setup)
- app/api/routes.py (apply decorators)
- pyproject.toml (add slowapi dependency)

## Acceptance Criteria
- Exceeding limit returns 429 Too Many Requests
- Response includes Retry-After header
- Limits are per-IP, not global

## Reference
See TODO.md 'Rate Limiting' section
close_reason: Rate limiting already handled at API Gateway level

title: Add CD: Deploy to AWS on push to main
description:
dispatched_by: mayor

Automate deployment when code lands on main.

## Requirements
1. Add GitHub Actions workflow for CD
2. Trigger on push to main branch
3. Run `just deploy` (wraps `cd infra && npx cdk deploy`)
4. Requires AWS credentials as GitHub secrets

## GitHub Secrets Needed
- AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID
- AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY
- AWS_REGION (or hardcode us-east-1)

## Files
- .github/workflows/cd.yml (new)

## Existing Recipe
```bash
just deploy  # cd infra && npx cdk deploy
```

## Acceptance Criteria
- Push to main triggers deployment
- Workflow uses existing CDK infrastructure
- Failures notify (GitHub Actions default)
close_reason: Added .github/workflows/cd.yml that deploys to AWS on push to main using CDK. Workflow configured with AWS credentials from GitHub Secrets.
